title: Should Universal Basic Income Be Implemented Globally by 2030?

messages.message: I argue FOR implementing UBI globally by 2030. Here's why: Automation is displacing workers at an unprecedented rate. By 2030, AI and robotics could eliminate 800M jobs worldwide. UBI provides a safety net that enables economic stability, reduces poverty, and gives people freedom to pursue education, entrepreneurship, or caregiving. Countries like Kenya and Finland have shown promising pilot results. The question isn't whether we can afford UBI—it's whether we can afford NOT to have it as our economy transforms.
